answer: Each identity tends a violet beacon post on an ocean shore, locking 70 credits. Each epoch brings a fresh serialled pigment reading; its light fades 10% per missed epoch to zero. An auditor recomputes pigment from the ocean tide table; a reading off by over 3% or a reused serial burns it. First 33, k-th 33+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,029,000 plus 70,000 locked; pool 40,000. Rented beacons cannot fake fresh readings. An honest keeper pays 33 once.
